countries.name: Nepal

countries.name: Philippines

regions.name: Tamil Nadu

regions.name: Kerala
regions.description: God's Own Country, famed for tranquil palm-fringed backwaters, Ayurvedic wellness retreats, and misty tea plantations of Munnar.

regions.name: Rajasthan
regions.description: The land of Maharajas, colossal desert hill forts, opulent mirrored palaces, and kaleidoscopic desert festivals.

regions.name: Uttar Pradesh

regions.name: Maharashtra

regions.name: Kansai (Kyoto, Osaka, Nara)

regions.name: Kanto (Tokyo & Mount Fuji)

regions.name: Northern Thailand (Chiang Mai)

destinations.name: Madurai & Meenakshi Amman
destinations.description: One of the oldest continuously inhabited cities in the world, renowned for the colossal, rainbow-hued gopurams of the historic Meenakshi Sundareswarar Temple complex.
destinations.whyVisit: To witness living Dravidian temple architecture, thousand-pillar halls, night pooja processions, and authentic Chettinad culinary feasts.

crowdPrediction.factors: Peak during Chithirai Festival (April/May) and weekend temple darshan

transportation.localTransit: Prepaid auto-rickshaws, city buses, app-based cabs (Ola/Uber)
transportation.tips: Walking is ideal around the concentric streets surrounding Meenakshi Temple.

foodToTry.name: Kari Dosa
foodToTry.desc: Crisp three-layered minced mutton dosa, Madurai's pride

foodToTry.name: Jigarthanda
foodToTry.desc: Legendary cooling beverage made with almond gum, condensed milk, and nannari syrup

foodToTry.name: Parotta & Salna
foodToTry.desc: Flaky layered flatbread soaked in aromatic spicy gravy

heritageInfo.era: Classical Era (6th Century CE / 16th Century Nayak renovation)
heritageInfo.significance: Spiritual epicenter of classical Tamil culture with 14 gopurams reaching up to 52 meters.

destinations.name: Agra & The Taj Mahal
destinations.tagline: An immortal poem in ivory-white marble
destinations.description: Commissioned in 1632 by the Mughal emperor Shah Jahan to house the tomb of his favorite wife Mumtaz Mahal, it stands as the jewel of Muslim art in India.
destinations.whyVisit: To witness the world wonder glow soft pink at sunrise, explore the red sandstone Agra Fort, and wander the historic Mughal garden complexes.

crowdPrediction.factors: Always busy; sunrise slot offers lower crowds and ethereal lighting

transportation.nearestAirport: Indira Gandhi International Airport, New Delhi (DEL) - 210 km via Yamuna Expressway
transportation.nearestRailway: Agra Cantt (AGC) - Gatimaan Express connects from Delhi in 100 minutes
transportation.localTransit: Electric auto-rickshaws, battery-operated golf carts in heritage zone, Uber
transportation.tips: Taj Mahal is closed on Fridays. Book sunrise tickets online in advance.

foodToTry.name: Agra Petha
foodToTry.desc: Translucent candied ash gourd sweet available in flavors like Kesar and Paan

foodToTry.name: Bedai & Jalebi
foodToTry.desc: Puffy spiced lentil bread served with spicy potato curry and hot sweet spirals

foodToTry.name: Mughlai Korma
foodToTry.desc: Rich almond and cashew gravy infused with saffron and spices

heritageInfo.architecture: Mughal Architecture with Pietra Dura marble inlay
heritageInfo.significance: UNESCO World Heritage Site & one of the New Seven Wonders of the World.

destinations.name: Kyoto Ancient Temples
destinations.tagline: Heart of thousand-year imperial Shinto & Zen serenity
destinations.description: Former imperial capital of Japan for over a millennium, housing over 2,000 temples and shrines, including the shimmering Kinkaku-ji and 10,000 vermilion gates of Fushimi Inari.
destinations.whyVisit: To walk under glowing torii gates, meditate in dry Zen rock gardens of Ryoan-ji, and taste ceremonial Uji matcha tea.
destinations.bestTime: March to May (Sakura) & October to November (Autumn foliage)

crowdPrediction.factors: Extreme during Cherry Blossom week and mid-November Momiji

transportation.nearestAirport: Kansai International Airport (KIX) - 75 min on JR Haruka Express
transportation.nearestRailway: Kyoto Station (Tokaido Shinkansen bullet train from Tokyo in 135 mins)
transportation.localTransit: Kyoto City Subway, pristine bus network, electric rental bicycles
transportation.tips: Purchase an IC card (ICOCA/Suica) for seamless contactless transit across trains and buses.

foodToTry.name: Kaiseki Ryori
foodToTry.desc: Multi-course seasonal haute cuisine reflecting nature and zen philosophy

foodToTry.name: Yudofu
foodToTry.desc: Delicate simmered tofu served in dashi broth with ginger and scallions

foodToTry.name: Matcha Parfait
foodToTry.desc: Layers of Uji green tea jelly, matcha ice cream, and mochi

heritageInfo.era: Classical & Medieval Era (794–1868 CE Heian to Edo)
heritageInfo.architecture: Japanese Traditional Wooden Architecture & Shinto-Buddhist syncretism
heritageInfo.significance: Historic Monuments of Ancient Kyoto designated a UNESCO World Heritage site.

destinations.name: Angkor Wat Archaeological Park
destinations.tagline: The supreme masterpiece of the Khmer Empire
destinations.description: The largest religious monument on Earth, originally constructed as a Hindu temple for the god Vishnu before gradually transforming into a sacred Buddhist sanctuary.
destinations.whyVisit: To marvel at bas-relief apsaras, watch the sun rise behind five iconic lotus towers, and explore tree-strangled Ta Prohm.

crowdPrediction.factors: Early morning sunrise pool gathers hundreds; outer temples remain tranquil

transportation.nearestRailway: N/A (Buses and flights from Phnom Penh)
transportation.localTransit: Dedicated tuk-tuks with English-speaking drivers, e-bikes
transportation.tips: Hire a tuk-tuk driver for the full-day grand temple circuit.

foodToTry.name: Fish Amok
foodToTry.desc: Steamed curried catfish wrapped in banana leaves with lemongrass and coconut cream

foodToTry.name: Nom Banh Chok
foodToTry.desc: Khmer noodles bathed in green fish gravy topped with fresh herbs

heritageInfo.architecture: Khmer Temple Mountain style with sandstone carvings
heritageInfo.significance: Heart of the ancient Khmer civilization spanning 400 square kilometers.

destinations.name: Borobudur Temple Compound
destinations.tagline: The world's grandest Buddhist pyramid surrounded by twin volcanoes
destinations.description: Built in the 9th century during the reign of the Sailendra Dynasty, this colossal stepped pyramid features 504 Buddha statues and 72 perforated stupas.
destinations.whyVisit: To climb through three Buddhist cosmological tiers (Kamadhatu, Rupadhatu, Arupadhatu) against sunrise mists over Mount Merapi.

crowdPrediction.factors: Regulated visitor quotas keep temple terrace crowd manageable

transportation.localTransit: Private car charters, tourist shuttle buses, Grab taxis
transportation.tips: Book the special sunrise ticket for breathtaking morning light.

foodToTry.name: Gudeg Jogja
foodToTry.desc: Slow-braised young jackfruit sweetened with palm sugar and coconut milk

foodToTry.name: Bakpia Pathok
foodToTry.desc: Flaky round pastry stuffed with sweetened mung bean paste

heritageInfo.significance: UNESCO World Heritage Site and the single largest Buddhist temple in existence.

destinations.name: Shirakawa-go Historic Village
destinations.tagline: Fairy-tale steep thatched gassho-zukuri mountain houses
destinations.description: Tucked away in the snow-blanketed Hida mountains, Shirakawa-go features unique prayer-hands thatched farmhouse architecture built without nails to withstand heavy snowfall.
destinations.whyVisit: Stay overnight in a 250-year-old wooden farmhouse, savor Hida beef sukiyaki, and view winter night illumination.

crowdPrediction.factors: Special winter illumination nights require lottery reservations

transportation.nearestRailway: Takayama Station (JR Takayama Main Line) - 50 min via Nohi Express Bus
transportation.tips: Luggage storage is available at the Shirakawa-go bus terminal.

foodToTry.name: Hida Beef Nigiri
foodToTry.desc: A5 marbled beef lightly blowtorched on rice crackers with sweet soy

foodToTry.name: Gohei Mochi
foodToTry.desc: Skewered pounded rice coated in walnut and sweet miso glaze

heritageInfo.architecture: Gassho-zukuri ('constructed like hands in prayer') thatched timber framing
heritageInfo.significance: UNESCO World Heritage Site preserving ancient Japanese alpine communal life.

destinations.name: Ziro Valley & Apatani Plateau
destinations.tagline: Pristine pine-clad basin of the sustainable Apatani tribe
destinations.description: An idyllic plateau framed by mist-shrouded Himalayan foothills, celebrated for indigenous bamboo architecture, ingenious wet-rice paddy systems, and the open-air Ziro Music Festival.
destinations.whyVisit: To experience a living UNESCO-proposed cultural landscape where harmony between humans and pristine nature has thrived for centuries.
destinations.bestTime: March to October (Ziro Festival in late September)

crowdPrediction.factors: Except during annual music festival week, peaceful rural sanctuary

transportation.tips: Inner Line Permit (ILP) required for Indian tourists; PAP for foreigners.

foodToTry.name: Pika Pila
foodToTry.desc: Traditional pickle made with pork fat, bamboo shoots, and fiery king chili

foodToTry.name: Apong
foodToTry.desc: Fermented organic millet or rice wine served in bamboo tumblers

heritageInfo.architecture: Organic Bamboo & Cane Stilt Houses (Nyibu architecture)
heritageInfo.significance: On UNESCO tentative list for outstanding sustainable agro-cultural landscape.

heritage.name: Arulmigu Meenakshi Sundareswarar Temple
heritage.significance: Dedicated to Goddess Meenakshi (an avatar of Parvati) and her consort Sundareswarar (Shiva), it features 14 majestic gopurams encrusted with thousands of mythological figures.

historyTimeline.event: Founding mentioned in ancient Sangam literature.
Ransacked during Malik Kafur's southern raid.
Restored and greatly expanded into present grandeur by the Nayak rulers.
Extensive Maha Kumbhabhishekam restoration celebrating polychrome gopurams.

heritage.name: The Taj Mahal
heritage.architecture: Mughal Architecture (Persian, Indian, and Islamic fusion)
heritage.significance: Universally admired masterpiece of world heritage, constructed using Makrana white marble inlaid with 28 varieties of precious and semi-precious stones.

historyTimeline.event: Mumtaz Mahal passes away; Emperor Shah Jahan commissions the mausoleum.
Main domed mausoleum completed by over 20,000 artisans.
Surrounding complex, gardens, and mosque finalized.
Inscribed as a UNESCO World Heritage Site.

heritage.name: Fushimi Inari-Taisha Shrine
heritage.significance: Head shrine of Inari, the Shinto kami of rice and agriculture. Celebrated for its Senbon Torii—over 10,000 vivid vermilion torii gates winding up sacred Mount Inari.

historyTimeline.event: Founded on Inariyama hill by the Hata clan.
Relocated to its present location at the request of monk Kukai.
Main hall rebuilt following destruction during the Onin War.
Designated as part of UNESCO Ancient Kyoto heritage.

heritage.name: Angkor Wat Temple
heritage.significance: Commissioned by King Suryavarman II, representing Mount Meru—the home of the devas in Hindu mythology—surrounded by a 5-kilometer-long moat.

historyTimeline.event: King Suryavarman II begins construction as royal mausoleum for Vishnu.
Gradual transformation into a Theravada Buddhist temple complex.
Visited by Portuguese friar Antonio da Magdalena who praised its miraculous design.
Inscribed onto UNESCO World Heritage list.

heritage.name: Borobudur Buddhist Stupa
heritage.significance: Colossal stepped pyramid temple made of two million volcanic stone blocks representing the Buddhist path to enlightenment.

historyTimeline.event: Commenced under the Sailendra Dynasty.
Abandoned following decline of Hindu-Buddhist kingdoms and volcanic eruptions.
Rediscovered by Sir Thomas Stamford Raffles.
Designated a UNESCO World Heritage Site following UNESCO restoration.

virtualTours.title: Meenakshi Sundareswarar Temple Hall of Thousand Pillars
virtualTours.audioGuideText: Welcome to the Meenakshi Sundareswarar Temple. You stand before the sanctum where classical Dravidian craftsmanship reaches its zenith. Notice the thousand intricately carved granite pillars, each carved from a single piece of stone. If you look upwards, the ceiling is adorned with vibrant cosmological mandalas representing the cosmic dance of Shiva.

hotspots.title: South Gopuram
hotspots.description: The tallest tower reaching 51.9 meters high, featuring over 1,511 colorful stucco mythological figures.

hotspots.title: Potramarai Kulam (Golden Lotus Tank)
hotspots.description: Sacred pond where devotees bathe. Legend states the Sangam academy judges tested literary works here.

hotspots.title: Musical Granite Pillars
hotspots.description: Five carved pillars near the northern tower that produce distinct Carnatic musical notes when gently struck.

virtualTours.title: Taj Mahal Inner Charbagh & Mausoleum Platform
virtualTours.audioGuideText: You are standing on the marble plinth of the Taj Mahal. The symmetry is mathematically flawless from every angle. Notice how the four surrounding minarets lean outward by a fraction of a degree—an intentional structural design to ensure that in the event of an earthquake, they would fall away from the sacred tomb.

hotspots.title: Central Marble Dome
hotspots.description: Rising 35 meters high, the onion dome is crowned with a gilded lotus finial blending Hindu and Persian motifs.

hotspots.title: Pietra Dura Inlay Panels
hotspots.description: Delicate floral scrollwork crafted with lapis lazuli, jade, turquoise, and carnelian inlaid into white Makrana marble.

hotspots.title: Yamuna River Promenade
hotspots.description: The northern terrace looks out over the sacred Yamuna river, offering panoramic reflections at twilight.

virtualTours.title: Fushimi Inari Senbon Torii Path
virtualTours.audioGuideText: Step into the vermilion tunnel of Fushimi Inari-Taisha. The distinctive orange-red hue, known as shu-iro, is believed to repel evil spirits and preserve the sacred cedar wood. Look closely at the black calligraphy carved onto each pillar: these are the names and dates of individuals and companies who dedicated each gate as a prayer for prosperity.

hotspots.title: Kitsune Fox Messenger
hotspots.description: Stone fox statues holding the key to the rice granary in their mouths, serving as messengers of the kami Inari.

hotspots.title: Senbon Torii Archways
hotspots.description: Dense corridor of thousands of torii gates creating an enchanting tunnel of light and shadow.

hotspots.title: Omokaru Stone
hotspots.description: Make a wish and lift the stone lantern top. If it feels lighter than anticipated, your wish will soon be fulfilled.

virtualTours.title: Angkor Wat Central Sanctuary & Moat Causeway
virtualTours.audioGuideText: Welcome to Angkor Wat. As you cross the sandstone causeway spanning the sacred moat, you enter a microcosm of the Hindu universe. The outer moat symbolizes the mythical cosmic ocean, while the five soaring central towers represent the five peaks of holy Mount Meru.

hotspots.title: Churning of the Ocean of Milk
hotspots.description: A 49-meter bas-relief carving depicting 88 devas and 92 asuras churning the cosmic ocean to release the elixir of immortality.

hotspots.title: Central Lotus Tower
hotspots.description: The supreme sanctum soaring 65 meters above ground level, originally enshrining Vishnu.
